{"Chat":{"10":""Where am I from? Do you ask everyone that?" The Navigator laughs – he's just teasing. "No, I understand. It's the accent, isn't it? I'm an Empyrean, but my English is a Londoner's. I grew up there. Worked for the Empyreal Ambassador in London."

He straightens, proudly. "My master negotiated the deal that led to the opening of the Avid Horizon. Not many can say that."","30":""That was kind of you, Captain. I had hoped that having someone speak for me, show what I've made of myself, would help. Glad it wasn't needed, of course. But you were there in case it was."

He touches your arm. "I value that."","40":"It is hard to engage the Navigator's attention. He is rapt in thought. "Oh, the crew are doing well, Captain. They trust you. That's important."

He returns to reading, and will say nothing of himself.","60":"The body of the Navigator's friend sits in the Navigator's desk chair, by the window. The Navigator has taken a crate from the hold to serve as his own chair. 

"A good officer can always improvise!" The Navigator welcomes you into his cabin and offers you his bed to sit on. "I don't suppose you've any tweezers, have you? I keep getting splinters from my new stool." He laughs, warmly. "No matter. It's worth the discomfort. This is right."","70":""Are we close? Am I needed at my station?" The Navigator's eyes are bright; he's raring for battle. 

When you ask after the crew, his response is prepared. "I've just been round, Captain. They're as battle-ready as they'll ever be. Lead us to the fight and we'll give you our all."","80":""Oh, Captain! That was something." The Navigator is filled with nervous energy; he paces across his cabin. 

"My friend saw the whole thing – he watched from here. Saw us besting a creature vaster than us, more ancient, more experienced in surviving the inky expanse. We came together as a crew and were victorious. Truly, we are as any noble warrior."

He catches your eye and looks slightly abashed. "The crew fought well, Captain. That deserves recognition."","90":""Come in!" The Navigator has put his well-thumbed book of the 'Epic of King Gesar' to one side. He is mid-way through 'Scheherazade, or the One Thousand and One Nights'. He places a bookmark in it, and stands to greet you.

"Is there anything you miss, from before we came through? I always thought it would be the food. But it's not that. It's the stories. Before, when I read these, they needed magic to be real. Here... so much happens, they are more like someone's journal." He shrugs. "They're still exciting. But not the same."","100":""Good to see you, Captain." The Navigator's friend still sits by the window. A pillow has been placed behind his head, and a book is balanced on his lap. 

The Navigator catches your glance. "Thought I'd make him comfortable. Didn't know how long it would be till we found this magician, and his tiger." He blushes. "I haven't, ah, told the crew what we're looking for. My work needs their respect. I don't want them to think me silly."","1200":""Oh!" The Navigator hadn't responded to your knock; you'd been forced to let yourself in. He has moved his friend from the window, and was staring out of it in a reverie. "Did I thank you, Captain? For the big cat?" 

He's quiet for a long while. "Do you think all cats have that duality? That they contain two beings?" He turns to you. "Sometimes I feel like I'd have to be two people to meet the promises I made my friend. I still have to try, though. Because I love him. I have to try."","1300":"The Navigator reports on the crew the moment you enter. "I  haven't told them I requested we visit Death's Door. They wouldn't thank me. But they have noticed a change, despite my efforts. A stoker said I seemed 'determined'. 'Calmer'. That sounds like a good thing.

"There's something relaxing about having made a decision." He smiles fondly as he looks towards his friend, currently lying in his bunk. "No matter what it is."","1400":""Please, come in." The Navigator is quiet, and focused. He responds to your questions formally, providing concise and accurate details of the state of the crew and the engine. He steers away from anything about himself. 

As you leave, he meets your eye. "Does Death's Door wait for us all? I have to hope not. It's almost enough to make me devout, if it would give me a choice."","0":""I'm settling in nicely, thank you. You've a good crew here. And a sharp one. They've already realised it's wise not to bet against me at cards." 

He grins. "They demanded I stop being easy on them. They can tell when I aim to lose. I'm not an excellent liar."","50":""Have you ever made a promise, certain at the time you wouldn't be able to keep it? I've been thinking about it, ethically." There's a small pile of philosophy books by his bed. He must have found them at last port.

"I swore to my friend, so that he could die happy. Would he really mind if I failed him? I don't think that matters. He always trusted me. I couldn't live with letting him down."

It seems like your First Officer will not be able to focus until he has been to Eagle's Empyrean.","1700":""Are we making progress to Lustrum, Captain?" The Navigator is eager, but not anxious. "I am not eager to part with my oldest friend, but I've made a decision. The time has come to move on."

He is calmer than you have seen him. When you ask why, he is straightforward. "I've decided to believe that you can earn your own death. I will grant my friend the burial he deserves, then will live the best life I can." He laughs. "It was that, or to go mad."","1600":""Are we making progress to a Weft, Captain?" The Navigator is eager, but not anxious. "I am not eager to part with my oldest friend, but I've made a decision. The time has come to move on."

He is calmer than you have seen him. When you ask why, he is straightforward. "I've decided to believe that you can earn your own death. I will grant my friend the burial he deserves, then will live the best life I can." He laughs. "It was that, or to go mad."","2000":"The Navigator begins with a run down of the state of the crew. It is both concise, and thorough. He requests an update of your own status – that he might assist were you indisposed. Work done, he relaxes.

"Are you fond of poker, Captain? I hear a game has been arranged for after the shift change. We could join in. It would be interesting to see whether my luck holds.

"Otherwise, of course, if you wanted to take the engine exploring, I'm ready to plot a course. I'm up for any adventure." Did he actually wink?"},"Mother":{"0":"Mother","10":"The house is small, but is in an expensive location. It is well-kept: the windows are clean, the steps freshly swept. Asphodel is flourishing in an urn by the steps.

"It still feels like home." The Navigator gazes at the front door. "It feels strange to know I'm just visiting."","20":"The Grieving Matriarch is determined you'll join her for tea. She even refuses to let the servants assist. She is rushing towards the kitchen when the Navigator intervenes.

"We can't stay long. I mustn't impose on the captain. I promise I'll come back soon." He draws the Matriarch close, and lowers his voice. "I came to ask... May I borrow the key? I haven't been able to pay my respects." 

The Grieving Matriarch looks mortified."},"Magician":{"0":"Magician","1000":""I've surpassed my father, you know. And he could fill Mahogany Hall." She pats the Navigator's arm. "I'm certainly the only person who could do this as cheaply, and with as few accoutrements.

"In fact, I only need one more thing." She beams and looks at you, expectantly.","1100":"Miss Peppercorn stands by the brass framed mirror. While she waits for you to procure a cat, she practices sleight of hand. 

She is currently making a cane appear from thin air. The ease with which she makes it appear and disappear is in marked contrast to her fumbles as she tries to twirl it dramatically."},"Chat1":{"0":""I'm settling in nicely, thank you, Captain. You've a good crew here. And a sharp one." The Navigator already has visited every crewmember at their station.","30":"The Navigator takes his feet off his desk when you enter his cabin. He's been reading the Epic of King Gesar. "I always could get lost in it. Now, rereading it feels... more important."","1400":"The Navigator doesn't react when you knock. When you enter without permission, he apologises. "Sorry, Captain. I was thinking."","10":"The Navigator takes his feet off his desk when you enter his cabin. He's been reading. "I didn't realise how much I missed reading."","1300":"The Navigator is sitting at his desk. He holds up the Epic of King Gesar. "I've been reading it aloud to Altan. Figured it was finally my turn."","60":"The Navigator is sitting on his bunk – it's the only available seat. He holds up the Epic of King Gesar. "I've been reading it to Altan. Figured it was finally my turn.""}}
translation:
{"Chat":{"10":""我来自哪里？你会问每个人这个问题吗？"领航员笑了笑——他只是在跟你打趣，"不，我明白，是口音的问题，对吧？我是上国人，但我说的是伦敦腔的英语。我是在伦敦长大的，曾为上国驻伦敦大使馆工作。"

他挺直了身子，自豪地说："我的主人促成了使渴求之地平线开启的协定。世上能这么说的人可不多。"","30":""你那样做真是太好了，车长。我原本希望有人能替我说说话，展示我如今的样子，这样可能会比较好。当然，最后不需要也好。但你能在那儿，我很感激。"

他轻轻碰了碰你的手臂，"我很珍视这一点。"","40":"要引起领航员的注意不太容易。他陷入了沉思。"哦，列车员们很好，车长。他们信任你。那很重要。"

他重新投入到书中，不愿谈及自己。","60":"领航员的朋友的尸体坐在窗边的书桌椅上。领航员从货舱搬来一个箱子当作自己的椅子。

"一个好车务官总能即兴应变！"领航员欢迎你进入他的舱室，还请你坐到他的床上。"你有没有镊子？我坐这个新凳子总扎刺。"他愉快地笑着。"不过无所谓。这点不适我受得了。这是对的。"","70":""快到了吗？我该回我的岗上了吗？"领航员双眼发亮，急切地等待战斗。

当你问及列车员时，他早已准备好回答。"我刚刚巡视过，车长。他们已经做好了最充分的战斗准备。带我们去战斗吧，我们会全力以赴。"","80":""哦，车长！真是了不起的一战。"领航员浑身紧绷，在舱室里踱来踱去。

"我的朋友看到了全过程——他就在这儿目睹我们击败了一个比我们庞大、古老、在这片墨黑虚空中更为老练的存在。我们团结一心，最终取得胜利。我们堪比任何贵族战士。"

他与你对视时有些羞涩地低下头："列车员们打得很好，车长。他们值得被表彰。"","90":""进来吧！"领航员将翻得起皱的《格萨尔王史诗》放到一边，正在读《一千零一夜》。他插上书签，起身迎接你。

"你有没有怀念以前的生活？我一直以为我最怀念的是食物。但其实不是。是那些故事。以前读这些时，它们要靠魔法才变得真实。而在这里……发生的事情太多，这些故事更像是别人的日记。”他耸耸肩。“它们依然精彩。但感觉不同了。"","100":""很高兴见到你，车长。"领航员的朋友仍坐在窗边。头后放了一个枕头，腿上放着一本书。

领航员注意到你的目光。"我想让他舒服点。我不知道我们什么时候才能找到那位魔术师，还有他的老虎。"他脸红了，"我还没，嗯，告诉列车员我们在找什么。我的工作依赖于他们的尊敬。我不希望他们觉得我幼稚。"","1200":""哦！"你敲门他没应，最后你只好自己进来。他已经把朋友从窗边挪开，自己却正沉思地望着窗外。"我有没有谢谢你，车长？为了那只大猫？"

他沉默了一会儿。"你觉得所有的猫都有双重性吗？它们体内有两个存在？"他转向你，"有时我觉得我也要变成两个人，才能实现对朋友做出的承诺。但我必须努力。因为我爱他。我必须努力。"","1300":"你一进门，领航员便汇报起列车员的状况："我还没告诉他们，是我要求去死亡之门的。他们不会对这一决定感到感激。但尽管我努力掩饰，他们还是察觉到我变了。一个司炉说我看起来‘坚定’、‘更平静’。听上去像是件好事。"

"做出决定本身就有种让人安心的感觉。"他温柔地看着床上的朋友，"无论那个决定是什么。"","1400":""请进。"领航员语气平静，神情专注。他以正式的语气回答你的提问，简洁准确地说明列车员与机车的状况。他避开一切与自己有关的话题。

你准备离开时，他与你对视："死亡之门会为我们所有人敞开吗？我只能祈祷不会。若信仰能让我做出选择，恐怕我都要开始信教了。"","0":""我过得还不错，谢谢你。你这里的列车员很不错，而且很聪明。他们已经意识到，在玩牌时不要和我打赌比较明智。"

他咧嘴一笑："他们还要我别再放水了。他们能看出来我什么时候故意输。我不太擅长撒谎。"","50":""你有没有立过一个你明知道自己可能做不到的承诺？我最近一直在想这件事，考虑这方面的伦理问题。"他床边有一小堆哲学书，看来是在上一个车站找到的。

"我向我朋友起过誓，只为了让他能安心离去。他真的会介意我没做到吗？我觉得那不重要。他一直都信任我。我不能忍受让他失望。"

看起来你的大副直到去过雄鹰之苍天上国之前都无法专心。","1700":""我们离伍载镇还有多远，车长？"领航员充满期待，却并不焦虑。"我并不渴望与我最亲密的朋友告别，但我已经做出了决定。是时候向前走了。"

他比你以往见过的都要平静。当你问他原因时，他坦率地说："我决定相信，人可以赢得属于自己的死亡。我会给我的朋友一个应得的葬礼，然后过上我能过的最好的人生。"他笑了笑，"不然的话，我可能会疯掉。"","1600":""我们离纬线还有多远，车长？"领航员充满期待，却并不焦虑。"我并不渴望与我最亲密的朋友告别，但我已经做出了决定。是时候向前走了。"

他比你以往见过的都要平静。当你问他原因时，他坦率地说："我决定相信，人可以赢得属于自己的死亡。我会给我的朋友一个应得的葬礼，然后过上我能过的最好的人生。"他笑了笑，"不然的话，我可能会疯掉。"","2000":"领航员一开始便简明扼要地报告列车员状况。他要求了解你的状态——以便在你不适时提供协助。工作结束后，他放松下来。

"你喜欢扑克吗，车长？我听说换班后有一场游戏要开。我们可以一起去。看看我的运气是否还在。"

"当然，如果你想带机车去探险，我也可以马上设定航线。我随时准备好迎接冒险。"他刚才是不是在对你挤眉弄眼？"},"Mother":{"0":"母亲","10":"房子不大，但位于昂贵的地段。维护得很好：窗明几净，台阶刚打扫过。台阶旁的瓮中盛放着盛开的水仙花。

"这里依然有家的感觉。"领航员凝望着前门，"只是一想到我如今只是个访客，便感觉有些奇怪。"","20":"悲伤的族母坚持要你留下喝茶。她甚至不让仆人帮忙，自己匆匆忙忙地往厨房去，这时领航员拦住了她。

"我们不能久留。我不能给车长添麻烦。我保证很快会回来。"他把族母拉近些，压低声音说："我来是问您……能把钥匙借给我吗？我还没能去致敬。"

悲伤的族母看上去很羞愧。"},"Magician":{"0":"魔术师","1000":""我已经超过我父亲了，你知道吗？他可是能让桃花心木厅座无虚席的人。"她拍了拍领航员的手臂，"我是唯一能用这么少的道具、花这么少的钱做到这一点的人。"

"事实上，我只还需要一样东西。"她满脸笑容地看着你，充满期待。","1100":"派伯康小姐站在一面黄铜边框的镜子旁。等待你带来一只猫的间隙，她在练习障眼法。

她现在正在凭空变出一根手杖。她变出又消失的动作行云流水，与她试图旋转手杖时的笨拙形成鲜明对比。"},"Chat1":{"0":""我已经适应得很好了，谢谢你，车长。你的列车员都很棒，也都很聪明。"领航员已经拜访过每一位列车员了。","30":"你走进他的舱室时，领航员放下了搁在桌上的双脚。他正在读《格萨尔王史诗》。"我总会在这本书里迷失自己。现在重读它……感觉更加重要了。"","1400":"你敲门时，领航员没有反应。你未经许可走进去，他才回过神来。"对不起，车长。我刚才在走神。"","10":"你走进他的舱室时，领航员放下了搁在桌上的双脚。他正在看书。"我没意识到自己有多怀念读书这件事。"","1300":"领航员坐在桌边。他举起手中的《格萨尔王史诗》："我一直在读给阿尔坦听。我想，是时候轮到我了。"","60":"领航员坐在铺位上——那是唯一的座位。他举起手中的《格萨尔王史诗》："我一直在读给阿尔坦听。我想，是时候轮到我了。""}}

{"lustrum_description":{"30":"You follow the Vagabond past Lustrum's outskirts, into the whirling whiteness beyond. Miles from civilisation, you find a mansion half-buried in snow, perched on a rocky outcrop. The Vagabond wades to the door and slams on the iron knocker.

After some time, the door eases open. A doddery butler peers out, his face so downcast it looks half-melted. "Welcome back, sir," says the Tragic Butler wearily. "A letter was delivered in your absence."","31":"The Vagabond sips his whisky before the fireplace, telling rambling stories about the parties he threw in the mansion's better days. The Tragic Butler stands to one side, mournfully dignified.","35":"The Vagabond sips his whisky before the fireplace, telling rambling stories about the parties he threw in the mansion's better days. The Tragic Butler stands to one side, mournfully dignified."},"old_tom":{"0":"","110":"The well-winds whip at your garments. The Vagabond's beard and coat flap wildly as he strides toward his pale, gaunt sister.

"Greetings, brother," says the Lank Minister with unconcealed contempt.

"Sister!" booms the Vagabond, with an exaggerated bow. "Aren't you going to thank me? I've brought your master another gift."","120":"Old Tom grips your shoulder and marches you to the well's edge. Fathomless darkness hungers below.

The Lank Minister and her followers have dropped in supplication, their faces pressed into the coal-black ice. "Here's another one," mutters Old Tom, staring down intently. "Their soul is bound to mine."

You follow his gaze and, for a moment, you can see almost to the well's depths. A glisten of foetid gold; a cluster of pale, grasping trees."}}
translation:
{"lustrum_description":{"30":"你跟随流浪汉穿过伍载镇的边缘地带，走进那片旋转纷飞的白茫茫世界。远离文明数英里之外，你们发现了一座半掩在积雪中的宅邸，孤零零地坐落在岩石突起之上。流浪汉趟雪走到门前，用力敲响了铁制门环。

过了一会儿，门缓缓打开。一位步履蹒跚的老管家探出头来，他的脸忧郁得仿佛已经半融化了。"欢迎回来，先生，"悲惨的管家疲惫地说道，"您不在时，有一封信寄到。"","31":"流浪汉坐在壁炉前啜饮威士忌，喃喃讲述那些宅邸昔日辉煌时他举办的宴会。悲惨的管家静静站在一旁，满脸哀伤，却保持着尊严。","35":"浪汉坐在壁炉前啜饮威士忌，喃喃讲述那些宅邸昔日辉煌时他举办的宴会。悲惨的管家静静站在一旁，满脸哀伤，却保持着尊严。"},"old_tom":{"0":"","110":"井口的狂风吹动你的衣摆。流浪汉的胡须与外套在风中剧烈飘舞，他大步走向那位面色苍白、消瘦的姐姐。

"兄长，"瘦弱的传教士满怀轻蔑地说道。

"妹妹！"流浪汉夸张地鞠了一躬，响亮地回应，"你不打算谢我一声吗？我又给你的主人带来了一个礼物。"","120":"老汤姆抓住你的肩膀，把你带到井边。深不见底的黑暗在下方蠢蠢欲动，仿佛在渴望吞噬一切。

瘦弱的传教士与她的信众已俯伏在地，脸贴着煤黑色的冰面。"又来了一个，"老汤姆低声说，目光牢牢盯着井底，"那人的灵魂已与我相连。"

你顺着他的视线望去，有短短一瞬，你隐约看清井的深处。一抹腐臭的金光：一团苍白、紧握不放的树木。"}}

Its subject matter remains to be decided.","2":"The Titania Imperial Museum is open.","3":"The Titania Art Museum is open.","4":"The Great Library is open."},"SletDescription":{"1":"The unused buildings of Bloom Bower are the new foundation for the Titania Museum, though its purpose has yet to be agreed. The Rhapsodic Mayor practically dances through the stonework, mentally drawing up floor plans and planning decorative touches in brass and bronze.","2":"The Titania Imperial Museum stands as a celebration of all nations of Earth, but mostly Britain. It features exhibits ranging from the Empress' 'liberation of India from the state of non-British rule' to the 'shameful split of the Traitor Colonies' in the 18th Century.\n\nA few quickly shushed voices ponder whether there might be a degree of colonial bias to some of these exhibits. These whisperers are directed to the Curator, a proud royalist happy to ease their concerns by informing them that no, there is not.","3":"The Titania Art Museum is already building a name for itself as one of Albion's greatest repositories of art, both real and modern. Any citizen can submit creations, and most of them have. Great halls are filled with statues in every material available, barely a wall lacks for a canvas whose paint has yet to completely dry.","4":"The Great Library of Titania is mostly empty shelves, the original settlers having brought few books with them. With each new arrival, however, shelves begin filling with essential texts, including volumes Q–T of the Britannica, the almost complete works of Shakespeare, and a rare copy of the 1631 'Wicked Bible' containing the infamous misprint 'thou shalt commit adultery'."},"PortAmbience":{"3":" A painter and her muse hurry to finish a new portrait for the art museum before the light changes.","4":" The Curator of the Library shuffles around in search of elderly visitors who might be willing to donate their collections.","2":" The air is split by the loud boom and shattering crystal of the Imperial Museum cannon marking the hour."}}
translation: {"PortSynopsis":{"1":"博物馆正在建设中，展览主题尚未确定。","2":"狄坦妮娅帝国博物馆现已开放。","3":"狄坦妮娅艺术博物馆现已开放。","4":"大图书馆现已开放。"},"SletDescription":{"1":"花亭未使用的建筑如今成为狄坦妮娅博物馆的新基础，尽管具体用途尚未达成共识。热情洋溢的市长几乎是在石墙间跳跃前行，在脑中勾画出楼层平面图，并设想着用黄铜和青铜装点细节。","2":"狄坦妮娅帝国博物馆是一场对地球各国（尤其是英国）的庆典。展览包括皇帝陛下“将印度从非英属状态中解放出来”的伟业，以及十八世纪“叛徒殖民地的可耻分裂”。\n\n少数声音悄声讨论，展览中是否存在某种殖民偏见。这些窃窃私语者被引向馆长——一位自豪的皇室主义者，他欣然安抚他们的疑虑，并告知：没有偏见，完全没有。","3":"狄坦妮娅艺术博物馆正逐步赢得“阿尔比恩最伟大艺术收藏地之一”的美誉，馆中收藏既有经典杰作，也有当代艺术品。任何市民皆可提交创作，而且大多数人都这么做了。巨大的展厅中陈列着各种材质的雕像，几乎每面墙上都挂着颜料尚未干透的画作。","4":"狄坦妮娅大图书馆中的书架大多空空如也——最初的定居者带来的书籍寥寥无几。然而随着每一位新来者的抵达，书架逐渐被各类重要文本填满，例如《大英百科全书》第Q至T卷、莎士比亚的几乎全部作品，以及一册罕见的1631年版“罪恶圣经”，该版本中误植了臭名昭著的戒律：“你应当犯奸淫。”"},"PortAmbience":{"3":"一位画家和她的缪斯急匆匆赶往艺术博物馆，在光线变幻前完成一幅新肖像。","4":"图书馆馆长在四处徘徊，寻找是否有年长访客愿意捐赠自己的藏书。","2":"每到整点，帝国博物馆的大炮轰然作响，震碎空气与水晶。"}}

translation: {"Unrest":{"10":"工人们默默地抱怨着他们的工作。","0":"布拉巴宗一片平静。工人们遵循他们的命运。但他们不该如此！","20":"动荡程度很低。监督者几乎不需要做什么就能控制工人。","40":"工人间隐约有些不满的低语，但仅限于此。","30":"动荡程度很低。工人们不断受苦，抱怨连连。","50":"工人们很不满。他们意识到面前的不公。但他们尚未看到改变的可能。","60":"工人们很不满。他们愿追随任何承诺改变他们命运的人。","70":"工人们愤怒了。暴怒的低语在布拉巴宗四处蔓延。","80":"工人们愤怒了。他们呼喊着，渴望解放。","90":"工人们发起罢工，并因此遭受苦难。但他们并未退缩。变革势在必行。","100":"布拉巴宗的工人群起反抗！"},"Revolt":{"0":"夹缝之地突然陷入寂静。监督者们不再需要他们的棍棒了。所有人都目送机车摇摇晃晃地驶离，直到消失在视野尽头。它的车长摇着头说：\"可怜的混账们。可怜，可悲的混账们。\"","100":"一群人潮从隧道涌出。监督者被挤压到墙边——无论是故意还是意外，结果都一样：痛苦的哀嚎四起。 \n这群人没有转向对付同胞——但工人们仍受伤了。这场失控的混战对所有人都充满危险。"}}

{"unseen_queen_description":{"1":"The Unseen Queen's throne-room is a ceaseless bustle of activity; servants attend her every whim, courtiers bombard her with anecdotes and wait in suspense for her laughter, stewards bring her petitions and scrolls. She waved them all away as soon as the herald announced your arrival, but they soon creep back around her.","0":"Amid the rubbish-heaps, space has been cleared for a throne of scrap metal and broken wood. Atop the throne sits a faded portrait. 

The frame is silver-painted wood; it depicts a noblewoman sitting before an open window, hands folded neatly in her lap. Over her shoulder shines a crescent moon. The face has been furiously scratched out. 

"I would prefer you not see me like this," says the Unseen Queen mournfully. Her voice is melodious, ethereal, and comes from nowhere."},"unseen_queen_first_mission":{"0":"When you ask, the rats cease to scurry and the flies no longer buzz. The Queen's portrait sits silently on her rusted throne.","1":"When you ask this question, the bustling courtiers whisper to each other eagerly. They withdraw, leaving you and the Queen momentarily alone."},"dustyards_description":{"1":"The Unseen Queen's castle is many leagues from your own, and you have ridden a great distance to get here. As you approach from a distance, you can see the castle sitting splendidly atop a mountain, silhouetted against the moon. Reaching it, however, is another matter entirely. 

The path becomes too steep for your exhausted destrier; you will have to proceed on foot, if you can find a path at all through the thick gorse.","0":"You descend to the deepest reaches of London, below even the shrouded slums. This dim realm is called Underlondon, and like most underthings, it is not mentioned in polite company. 

Only the most desperate scavengers venture into Underlondon. Here, the city's rubbish collects in heaps the size of hills; the city's refuse falls like unpleasant, unrelenting rain."},"search_for_queen":{"1":"Try to find a path to the castle","0":"Search amid the detritus for the so-called 'Unseen Queen'"},"didnt_find_queen":{"1":"You search for days, but the wooded mountain stubbornly refuses to yield up a path to the castle. After so much time wasted tramping back and forth, you sit on a tree-stump and wretchedly assess your situation.

Except... it's not a tree-stump. It's something which is dreadfully, dishearteningly squelchy. And you're no longer at the foot of a mountain, but at the foot of a mountain-size heap of rubbish. Where are you? How did you get here?","0":"You search for days, clambering across mountain-sized heaps of abandoned, rusting metal. But you don't find anything that could be said to resemble a queen."},"found_queen":{"1":"After a few hours of searching, the path reveals itself to you, opening up between the tangled trees with such a wonderful suddenness that you almost suspect magic at work. It doesn't take long to climb to the castle, where you call your name to the guard and wait as the drawbridge is lowered across a silver moat. 

"The Unseen Queen awaits you inside," says the guard. "You must have come far. Shall I order the servants to run a hot bath and fetch you a large dinner?"","0":"After a few hours of searching, you come across a curious sight. 

A section of the rubbish-heap has been assiduously cleared and flattened. The pieces of rubbish that remain seem to have been carefully chosen for aesthetic reasons – piping, wire, scrap metal – and assembled into something approaching a throne. 

And sitting in the throne, a faded old portrait."},"speak_to_the_queens_courtiers":{"1":"Speak to the Queen's courtiers","0":"Kneel and inspect the rats"},"queens_courtiers":{"1":"The Queen's courtiers are exceedingly polite. Some are even reverential. 

"The quest for the Cup is the highest of callings," explains her seneschal earnestly, nibbling at a wedge of cheese. "We are always pleased to harbour another sworn knight in our household."

After a moment's consideration, he rummages in his pockets and retrieves the small, dripping corpse of some unidentifiable creature. It looks like a cross between worm and crab. "Here," he says. "This is all I can give you for now. I hope it helps on your quest."

You thank him as fulsomely as you can, and try not to sound too taken aback.","0":"As you kneel, the rodents form a semi-circle around you. One of them squeaks, runs a little way, then runs back and squeaks again.

Finally you relent, and follow it between several mounds of rubbish. It stops beside the small corpse of some unidentifiable creature that looks like a cross between worm and crab.

Whatever this is, you've never seen it anywhere else. It might be a monster unique to London's undercarriage. Probably best to take it back to the engine for study."},"duelling_the_quester":{"1":"Your foe is waiting atop the hill, sitting astride a destrier of his own. He is a knight in burnished armour, brandishing a sword with a red hilt and black blade. His latest conquest lies mangled at his feet: a demon with eyes of burning coal and flayed skin. As the knight turns his horse, it tramples the demon's corpse.

"Have you come to challenge me for my sword?" demands the knight, his eyes gleaming coldly. "Come, then. You may take it blade-first."","0":"A crowd is forming around you, the Chamberlain, and a moaning overseer. "Why the delay, blaggard?" asks the Chamberlain, weaving his fountain pen back and forth like a sword. You grab his wrist, but he wriggles free. "Cheater! Fight me fair and square beneath the moonlight, coward!" He turns on his heels and flees, darting down an alleyway."},"shield_description":{"0":"You hold up the tarnished nameplate torn from the hull of the Parzifal.","1":"You hold up the shining shield, and the walls of the court dance with reflected moonlight. The courtiers start to applaud; the Queen gracefully inclines her head."},"throne_description":{"1":"You tell the Queen the tale of how you sat upon the Blindness Throne, and walked away with your eyesight intact. She listens raptly. The courtiers mutter admiringly among themselves. ","0":"You tell the Queen the tale of how you sat upon the Blindness Throne, and walked away with your eyesight intact. She listens raptly."},"cloak_description":{"1":"You unfurl the Cloak of the Lion, shimmering like gossamer. As the cloak ripples, the symbol of the lion seems to charge and pounce across the cloth. The courtiers raise an astounded cheer.","0":"You unfurl the dirty flag that you found entangled in a weather-vane."},"proven_worthy":{"0":""I am proud of you," says the Unseen Queen. A circle of rats and beetles form at your feet, squeaking and chittering their approval.","1":"The court erupts in wild cheering. A bottle of fine wine is thrust into your hands, and the seneschal proposes a toast. The Queen quietens celebrations with a single upraised finger."},"tournament_description":{"1":"The Grand Tournament stretches over countless acres of the Queen's gardens. The air is filled with song, laughter, the roaring of crowds; occasionally, the clash and clang of weaponry. Cooks are working tirelessly in the open air, roasting entire pigs on spits, mixing spices, baking crusty breads, and generally filling the air with a barrage of mouth-watering scents. 

The happy atmosphere among the spectators belies the tension among the knights. Each quester is determined to triumph and take up the completed Minute to Midnight.","0":"The Grand Tournament stretches over countless acres of mud and filth. The air is filled with sobbing, incoherent shouting, screams; occasionally, the rhythmic thud of fists hitting flesh.

There are hundreds of questers wandering back and forth in the desolation, some more lucid than others. Most are miserable specimens: bleary-eyed, shivering, wearing threadbare rags. You pass one on his hands and knees, furiously gnawing at a freshly-caught rat and complimenting a non-existent chef."},"jousting_success":{"0":"Your rival jouster is riding a wretched-looking mule, and waving a broomstick. You don't have a steed, so you recruit a sturdy quester and climb onto his shoulders.

You ride toward each other at incredible speed. (Incredible in its slowness.) Finally you meet at the centre, and you gently push the other fellow from his precarious perch. 

"Victory!" shouts one of the surrounding questers, banging two tin cans together. "Glory to the new champion!"","1":"Your rival jouster is riding a scarred destrier that looks as though it has something demonic in its ancestry. When you ride into the ring, your rival shoots you a sneer, then flips his visor shut. 

Your horses thunder toward each other at incredible, ground-shaking speed. Once, twice, three times you clash, and the spectators gasp as though they are witnessing the collision of two gods. Finally, on the fourth pass, you plant your lance squarely under the crook of his arm and lift him bodily from the saddle. 

"Victory!" shouts the announcer, to the sound of bugles. "Glory to the new champion!""},"jousting_fail":{"0":"Your rival jouster is riding a wretched-looking mule, and waving a broomstick. You don't have a steed, so you recruit a sturdy quester and climb onto his shoulders. 

You ride toward each other at incredible speed. (Incredible in its slowness.) Finally you meet in the middle, and his broomstick hits you in the solar plexus with surprisingly vicious accuracy. You topple over and land badly, twisting your arm underneath you. 

"Another challenger falls!" shouts one of the surrounding questers, banging two tin cans together.","1":"Your rival jouster is riding a scarred destrier that looks as though it has something demonic in its ancestry. When you ride into the ring, your rival shoots you a sneer, then flips his visor shut. 

Your horses thunder toward each other at incredible, ground-shaking speed. Once, twice, three times you clash, and the spectators gasp as though they are witnessing the collision of two gods. Finally, on the fourth pass, your rival plants his lance squarely in your solar plexus and lifts you bodily from the saddle. 

"Another challenger falls!" shouts the announcer, to the sound of bugles. It's an hour before you can walk again."},"melee_description":{"1":"The melee is a terrifying thing, like a monster in itself. A heaving mass of thrashing, convulsing armour. Occasionally a battered knight will crawl out from among the stamping boots and collapse, exhausted, at the edge.","0":"Now you can see clearly, you realise that the melee is not filled with armoured knights. It is a sprawling collection of questers, most of them scrawny and dressed in tatters, battering each other with fists and sticks. The portrait of the Unseen Queen watches it all from atop a heightened throne."},"challenger_description":{"0":"Even outside the moonlit realm, Isery strikes an impressive figure. They are tall, lithe, wearing practical clothes. Is that a set of clawed brass rings on their hand? They've dropped their earlier camaraderie – perhaps it was always a facade, or perhaps it has simply been muscled out by a desire to win. 

"How shall we decide this?" Isery asks. "Not that it matters. I can best you in any contest you care name."","1":"Isery is a knight in heavy steel mail, androgynous, alluring, their eyes glinting with the promise of violence. They've dropped the earlier camaraderie – perhaps it was always a facade, or perhaps it has simply been muscled out by a desire to win. 

"How shall we decide this?" they ask, their hand at the hilt of their sword. "Not that it matters. I can best you in any contest you care name.""},"search_for_queen2":{"0":"Ugh. Where to begin?","1":"Your vivid memory of that soaring, magnificent castle spurs you on. But first you must fight your way through the tangled woods."},"visit_queen":{"0":"She awaits you on her throne of rust.","1":"The drawbridge lowers with a creak. The guard waves you through."},"swear_fealty":{"0":"A tide of insects scatter as you kneel in the dust and pledge your loyalty.

"I accept your oath, my knight." The Queen doesn't sound displeased, though it is hard to tell anything from the scratched, faded portrait. "But if you truly wish to demonstrate your loyalty to me, I have just one plea. Forget what you see before you now, and instead choose to walk in a loftier reality. Do not turn your face from moonlight."","1":"The Queen's hand flies to her throat when you kneel and make your pledge. She seems both surprised and pleased. 

"If you truly wish to demonstrate your loyalty to me, my knight, I have but one plea." She raises her hand, catching the moonbeams that shine through the vaulted window. "Do not turn your face from moonlight. Walk forever in lofty dreams of the world as it should be.""},"minute_midnight":{"1":"You kneel before her throne, holding the black blade aloft. Her courtiers gasp.","0":"You went all the way to Brabazon in order to retrieve a fountain pen, you say, holding up the offending article."},"shield_description2":{"0":"You recovered it from the wreck of the Parzifal.","1":"You rescued it from the clutches of a sorceress."},"cloak_description2":{"1":"You crossed the Falchion Bridge and recovered it from the antlers of a buried monster.","0":"You found it at the top of a crumbling tower in Pan."},"draw_sword":{"1":"You draw the black-bladed sword from its scabbard. "This?"","0":"You retrieve the Chamberlain's battered fountain pen from your pocket. "This?""},"tournament_begins":{"1":"The Queen calls up her seneschal and hands him a scroll. "At last," mutters the seneschal. "The Grand Tournament. We've been waiting for years. How long do I have to make preparations?"

"The Tournament will begin in two weeks," says the Queen. The seneschal stares at her in abject horror, then turns on his heels and begins shrieking instructions to his attendants.","0":"How long does she need? "The Tournament will begin in two weeks," says the Queen. 

Silence settles across the wasteland. A gust of wind scatters scraps of paper across her lonely throne. "},"cup_hesitate":{"0":"For a moment the painting sits still and silent. Then, the Queen's voice murmurs once more from the canvas.","1":"The Queen hesitates, clasping her hands under her chin."}}

{"unseen_queen_description":{"1":"无形女王的王座厅永远喧闹不休：仆人们服侍她的每一个心血来潮，朝臣们向她倾诉逸闻轶事，期待她的笑声，管家则带来请愿书和卷轴。传令官一宣布你的到来，她便挥手让他们全部退下——但不久之后，他们便悄然回到了她身边。","0":"在废墟堆中，有一块地方被清理了出来，用来安放一个由废金属与破木头拼成的王座。王座之上摆着一幅褪色的肖像。

这幅画框是刷银的木头，画中是一位贵妇，端坐在一扇敞开的窗前，双手安放在膝上，月牙自她肩头照耀。她的脸已被凶狠地划去。

"我不愿你看到我如今的模样，"无形女王悲伤地说道。她的声音悠扬、空灵，仿佛从虚空中传来。"},"unseen_queen_first_mission":{"0":"你一提问，老鼠顿时停止奔跑，苍蝇也不再嗡嗡作响。女王的肖像安静地放在她那生锈的王座上。","1":"你问出这个问题时，喧闹的朝臣们兴奋地低声耳语。他们退下，暂时只留下你与女王二人独处。"},"dustyards_description":{"1":"无形女王的城堡离你所在之地有数个国度之遥，你为此跋涉了漫长旅途。当你远远望去时，能看到城堡华丽地矗立在山巅，在月光下显出轮廓。

但真正抵达那里，却远非易事。道路对你那疲惫不堪的战马来说已太过陡峭，你只能徒步前行——如果你能在这片荆棘丛生之地找出一条通路的话。","0":"你一路下降至伦敦最深的底部，比迷雾缠绕的贫民窟还要低。这里是一片名为“下伦敦”的幽暗地带，正如所有“下层之物”，它在体面人之间从不被提及。

只有最绝望的拾荒者才会踏入下伦敦。城市的垃圾在此堆成丘陵，废弃物如连绵不断的恶臭之雨降落于此。"},"search_for_queen":{"1":"试着找到通往城堡的路径","0":"在废墟中寻找这位所谓的“无形女王”"},"didnt_find_queen":{"1":"你找了好几天，但这座林木茂密的山脉倔强地拒绝显露通往城堡的路径。在徒劳地来回跋涉多日后，你沮丧地坐在一截树墩上，开始审视自己悲惨的处境。

等等……那不是树墩。那是某种令人不安、令人泄气的湿软之物。而你也不再身处山脚下，而是在一座山一样高的垃圾堆脚下。你在哪里？你是怎么来到这里的？","0":"你找了好几天，翻越一座又一座如山般高的废弃锈铁堆。但你没有发现任何能被称作“女王”的存在。"},"found_queen":{"1":"搜寻了几个小时后，小径终于在你眼前展开——在纠缠的树林间突然现出通途，令人惊喜得几乎让人怀疑是否有魔法介入。不久你便爬上了城堡，在门前报上姓名，等待吊桥放下，横跨那道银色的护城河。

"无形女王在里面等着你，"守卫说道，"你一定远道而来。是否让我命仆人准备热水澡，再送上一顿丰盛的晚餐？"","0":"搜寻了几个小时后，你遇见了一个奇异的景象。

垃圾堆的一部分被仔细清理并压平。剩下的那些碎片——管道、电线、金属废料——似乎都经过了精心挑选，出于审美考虑被组合成了某种近似王座的东西。

而在那王座上，坐着一幅褪色的旧肖像。"},"speak_to_the_queens_courtiers":{"1":"与女王的朝臣交谈","0":"跪在地上仔细查看这些老鼠"},"queens_courtiers":{"1":"女王的朝臣们极为有礼，有些人的神态近乎虔敬。

"对圣杯的追寻是最高的使命，"她的总管一边啃着一块奶酪，一边郑重其事地解释道，"我们一向乐于接纳又一位宣誓的骑士加入我们的宫廷。"

思索片刻后，他从口袋中翻出某种难以辨认的生物的小尸体——正滴着水，看起来像是蠕虫与螃蟹的混合体。"来，"他说，"我现在只能给你这个。希望它能在你的旅途中有所帮助。"

你尽可能满怀感激地道谢，同时努力掩饰自己的震惊。","0":"当你跪下时，那些啮齿动物围成了一个半圆。其中一只吱吱叫着跑出几步，又跑回来再叫了一声。

最终你妥协了，跟着它穿过几堆垃圾山。它停在一具小小的尸体旁——那是一种无法辨认的生物，看起来像是蠕虫与螃蟹的杂交。

你们以惊人的速度向彼此冲去。（惊人之处在于它的缓慢。）终于，你们在中央交汇，你轻轻地将对方从他摇摇欲坠的位置上推了下去。

It is time for the Rite of Renewal.","34":"The Empyreals light only enough lamps to pick their way to the site of the ceremony. Occasionally, there is a muffled curse as someone stumbles and falls. The Empyreals gather in a large crater, huddled together, waiting.

{"Root":{"0":"距离朦黄之月最近的陆地是月脊。它与上国主要车站之间的航道上，众多小型私人机车频繁穿行。每支车队宛如一群飞萤，被明月的光辉所吸引。

他们前来此地，是为了完成决议与更新的仪式，亦是为了举行月之授的祭礼。","1":"上国人簇拥在山坡两侧。无人站在山顶——那是留给工程师们的荣位：那些即将前往朦黄之月的勇敢之人。

在接下来的两周内，他们将驻留在月面高架平台上，执行必要的维修与养护工作。此举将招致潜藏于黑暗中的存在的敌意。仪式完成之前，他们不得归返。","67":"雄鹰汗之女乘坐一辆小巧、重装的机车抵达。她的侍卫维持着人群的距离，确保她登车后有充足空间。她身披天青色长袍，缀有金线刺绣，头饰上插满了鹰羽。

人群为她让出一条道路。她引领众人走向一处小湖的边缘——那便是月镜湖。","100":"仪式已成。雄鹰之苍天上国的子民将回归日常生活。","34":"工程师们已平安返回。他们站在上国民众的环形之外，衣衫破损，满身油污与尘土。但他们安然无恙。

你四周的灯笼一盏盏亮起，温暖的光芒缓缓扩散，愈发明亮。人群为他们让出道路，工程师们逆流而上，攀至仪式中央。"},"Branch":{"0":"","1":"上国人点亮了灯笼。一盏灯被递到你手中。众人分组，走向那座坡顶平坦的柔和山丘——那地方宛如一颗被揭去顶部的水煮蛋。上国之民簇拥于山坡两侧，无人站在山顶。

现在是更新仪式的时刻。","34":"上国人只点亮了足以照亮前路的灯笼。偶尔有人绊倒，发出低沉的咒骂声。他们聚集在一处巨大的陨坑中，彼此依偎，静候仪式开始。

现在是决议仪式的时刻。","67":"上国人穿上了最华丽的衣装。孩童被仔细擦洗，并强行套上正装——从他们不断扭动的姿态来看，显然极不习惯。众人满怀焦虑与期待，等待着鹰汗之女的到来。她将执行“月之授”祭礼。"}}
